segments.text:
V. 15.
Simon, ſon of Jonah—The Appellation Chriſt had given him, when he made that glorious Confeſſion, Mat. xvi. the Remembrance of which might make him more deeply ſenſible of his late Denial of Him whom he had ſo confeſt. Loveſt thou me?—Thrice our LORD aſks him, who had denied Him thrice: More than theſe—Thy Fellow-Diſciples, do? Peter thought ſo once, Mat. xxvi. 33. but he now anſwers only, I love thee, without adding more than theſe. Thou knoweſt—He had now learnt by ſad Experience, that Jeſus knew his Heart. My lambs—The weakeſt and tendereſt of the Flock.
